source_snapshot.procedure: Flash BIOS to the latest version, reboot, then check the version in BIOS setup and OS after preserving configuration/log evidence.
source_snapshot.criteria: The BIOS flash completes without errors and the correct version appears in BIOS and OS.
source_snapshot.script: Private check_fw_version_by_ipmitool_raw reference supports only a version readback, not the firmware write. Twenty minutes attended and twenty machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO because the state-changing pre-OS flash needs the user image and interactive vendor path; its log output incorrectly names the duplicate row's Previous Values action.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; requires signed compatible image, exact vendor utility/command, approval, stable power, recovery, monitored write and BIOS/OS verification.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly recognizes the critical state change but treats it as non-runnable rather than a package/approval-gated workflow and includes unrelated duplicate-row evidence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly converts the finite vendor artifacts and approval gates into REQUIRES and defines write/recovery boundaries.
historical_reviews.history: Sequence 535 is the distinct row-358 Previous Values variant and supplies no upgrade conclusion.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Latest-version wording must be resolved to one approved signed target image for the exact board; no generic or inferred flash command is safe.

original_test_intent: Upgrade the identified host to the explicitly approved latest compatible BIOS image, then prove successful completion, reboot recovery and matching version in BIOS Setup and the OS.
original_method: Verify host/board and current version, image signature/hash/compatibility, vendor command, configuration impact, power/console/recovery path and maintenance approval; monitor one uninterrupted write, reboot as specified, then collect independent BIOS Setup and OS/BMC health/version evidence.
manual_activity: Owner approves the exact board, image/hash, vendor flash procedure, maintenance window and recovery; operator supervises the console/write/reboot and confirms BIOS Setup version. The duplicate F2 Previous Values action is excluded.
required_inputs: Exact host/board identity and current BIOS version
Approved latest signed image/hash and compatibility/release reference
Vendor utility and exact upgrade command/procedure
Stable power, maintenance window and protected console
BIOS Setup and OS/BMC version readers
safety_requirements: Preserve logs/configuration before any optional rotation
Verify target and image immediately before write
Never interrupt, reset or power-cycle an active flash
Do not load Previous Values or other BIOS settings
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Validate vendor artifacts and recovery plan
Collect OS/BMC version and health evidence
engineer_actions: Ensure stable power and independent recovery
Supervise BIOS Setup and any pre-OS interaction
Own recovery and final DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek describes the intended upgrade but supplies no executable vendor command and incorrectly imports Previous Values from duplicate row 358. The private ipmitool script can support post-readback only and cannot perform or prove the flash itself.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only the exact vendor-approved upgrade command after all identity/image/recovery checks and explicit approval, monitor it without interruption, perform the specified reboot, then compare BIOS Setup and OS/BMC version plus health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Upgrade-to-latest target, reboot, two-surface version check and 20/20-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use signed-image verification, immediate target binding, complete flash telemetry and independent console/recovery, followed by multi-surface version and configuration/health comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the critical write target, approval, power and recovery contract explicit and isolates the readback-only script.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Adds image authenticity, board compatibility, configuration preservation and boot/health recovery without removing BIOS Setup or OS checks.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A compatible-looking but wrong or interrupted image can brick the board; the exact vendor procedure cannot be inferred from the library.

project_override_considerations: Project must define what 'latest' means for this board/release channel and approve the exact signed image, utility, activation and recovery. The ipmitool version script is post-check evidence only unless an approved procedure states otherwise.
expected_evidence: BIOS Setup plus OS/BMC version comparison
No hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define an upgrade. The readback Script is incomplete rather than contradictory, and the duplicate-row Previous Values text is explicitly isolated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation and acceptance are identifiable; vendor image/tool/command, approval and recovery are finite package/user prerequisites. Execution stops if those cannot be established.

review_improvement: Converts a broad non-runnable warning into a target-bound, approval-gated critical firmware workflow with explicit recovery and independent version evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A BIOS upgrade is technically executable by an agent only after the exact vendor artifact, command and recovery path are approved. The same code's manual F2 case and the readback-only script cannot define the write, so REQUIRES is safer and more accurate than DeepSeek's undifferentiated NO.
